item.title: [7.3] Global Market: Japan core inflation accelerates in July, strengthening case for BOJ rate hike
item.description:

item.title: [6.9] Harness Continual Learning: Continual Adaptation Beyond Model Parameters
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Continual learning has largely been model-centric, treating model parameters as the state that changes with sequential experience. Modern agents can also adapt through a harness of prompts, memories, tools, skills, and routing rules. Because these contents jointly shape later execution, a harness update can disrupt previously reliable behavior even when the model is frozen.

WHY IT MATTERS

It formalizes 'Harness Continual Learning' to adapt AI agents via external memory and prompts rather than model weights, addressing a real challenge in non-destructive agent evolution.
